From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>

Subject: Meeting notes: CAIQ walkthrough + sample artifact plan (3/3)

Hi Jason / Maria —

Thanks for the call today. Notes and action items below (brief):

Summary of what we covered:
- High-level CAIQ mapping (I walked through the prep doc we attached).
- Encryption: logs at rest are encrypted by default using customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private (KMS/HSM integration); hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS by default with option to bring your own for Enterprise plans. See CAIQ section: A.9 (Encryption) and A.12 (Key mgmt) in our prep doc.
- Logging & retention: default hosted retention is 30 days for access logs; Dedicated can be configured per contract up to 365 days. We will provide a 3-day anonymized sample during onboarding.
- Private deployment: redacted network diagram shared post-call; Aditya will prepare a diagram without IPs.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Aditya: upload anonymized access_logs_sample.tar.gz + README to secure transfer link (ETA: 3/4 COB).
- Hannah: share redwood_caiq_prep.docx as final PDF and add inline CAIQ section pointers (ETA: 3/4 EOD).
- Monica: send onboarding playbook + procurement checklist and confirm commercial contacts for SOC 2 evidence (ETA: 3/5).
- Jason: confirm whether Sentinel needs evidence for a specific SOC 2 period or the standard response set (ETA: 3/5).

Follow-ups / notes:
- We flagged a small follow-up item on logging provenance — Aditya to include a short paragraph in the README about how logs are generated and signed.
- Draft evidence transfer will be via secure SFTP link; final transfer method to be confirmed with Sentinel procurement.

Attachments provided during thread: redwood_caiq_prep.docx, sentinel_caiq_questions.xlsx, access_logs_sample.tar.gz (to be uploaded).

If I missed anything, please reply-all with corrections.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
